title: This startup wants to mount mini data centers onto people’s homes 👀 #tech #ai #trendingshorts
description:
Renewable energy startup, Span, has partnered with Nvidia to launch XFRA, a distributed data center system that mounts compute nodes on the exterior walls of homes and small businesses.

Each box uses Nvidia’s liquid-cooled RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs and taps unused capacity on local grids. 

Span claims it can deploy 8,000 units six times faster and at one-fifth the cost of a comparable 100-megawatt centralized facility.

Homeowners receive a smart electrical panel, battery backup, and discounted utilities.

The company is currently testing the system with homebuilder PulteGroup.

The approach targets surging AI inference demand as traditional data centers face multi-year grid delays.
